section.38: The Book of Manners and Etiquette

38.name_native: The Book of Manners and Etiquette

hadiths.text: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If a person were to cast a glance in your (house) without permission, and you had in your hand a staff and you would have thrust that in his eyes, there is no harm for you
